frequency_question: How often do liquidity intervention programs reach a pre-defined 'high-volume' tier within the first 18 months of operation?
membership_rule: Includes sovereign debt buyback or liquidity provision programs initiated by G7 central banks/treasuries since 2008; excludes emergency crisis-response programs (e.g., 2008 GFC, 2020 COVID) which are non-representative of standard treasury management.
coverage_note: 5 named; believed representative of non-crisis liquidity management.
known_gaps: Small sample size due to the rarity of formal, non-crisis treasury buyback programs.
skeleton: Total programs identified (5) where 4 reached higher volume tiers within the initial operational window.
validity_reason: The rate is based on structural policy behavior which remains stable across economic cycles unless the mandate of the institution changes.
